t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion for 2007, a temporary structure that no longer stands. It was designed by two people working together: the Danish-Icelandic artist Olafur Eliasson, known for large installations that use light, water and air temperature to shape what you feel, and the Norwegian architect Kjetil Thorsen, who co-founded the firm Snøhetta in 1987. An artist and an architect sharing the design is the point of the pavilion here. Nothing of it remains to see today.
